subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers + action-form — the chat↔dashboard loop

question: Should OpenClaw accept this bundled dashboard PR after the storage, dependency, sandbox-route, and proof blockers are fixed, or should the dashboard/action-form work be narrowed or deferred?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds persistent dashboard state, dependency metadata, an unauthenticated custom-widget route, and a dashboard-to-agent dispatch surface, so automation cannot grant the storage/security/product exceptions.

options.title: Fix Blockers Then Re-Review
options.body: Require the concrete fixes, dependency/secops authorization or removal, diagnostic proof, and a clean restack before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Exceptions
options.body: Maintainers and secops can intentionally approve JSON storage, dependency graph, and sandbox-route risks as policy exceptions for this feature.

options.title: Defer Or Narrow
options.body: Pause this PR until the lower dashboard stack lands, or split out only the lower-risk docs/convention pieces while storage and custom widgets are redesigned.

recommendation.title: Fix Blockers Then Re-Review
recommendation.body: Require the concrete fixes, dependency/secops authorization or removal, diagnostic proof, and a clean restack before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and SQLite/plugin-state direction affected by the decision.
